notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_8.md CB8-H Collection. IMPLEMENTED 2026-10-17 (cb8_holders.holders_snap), still a DRAFT until promoted. WHEN TO PROMOTE: after the q0160 PASS and a collector freeze check, ideally by 2026-10-21T04:00Z. The job records its first run in holders/deployment.json and refuses (exit 75, 30-min waits) until max(2026-10-21T06:00Z, first run + 2 h); T8_H1_start is the first complete capture at or after that time, pinned in snap/t8_h1_start.json with T8_H1_end = +21 d and T8_H_collect_max = +63 d. Promoting later only moves T8_H1_start later (first run + 2 h), it never backfills. QUEUE LIMIT: the worker marks a job failed after 48 consecutive exit-75 results (about 24 h). The job therefore returns a clean exit 0 (status idle_heartbeat) at least every 10 h while it waits (before the start, or between UTC days), which resets that count; exit 0 re-queues it at once and the next idle run exits 75 again. Daily rhythm: one snapshot per UTC day (plan with the seed arepo-cb8-holders-<date> written before the first request; one /holders request per market; 3 attempts then 'failed', counted apart from 'empty'); a day without a complete capture <= 2.5 h old is MISSED (marker, counted). Window 2 is pinned write-once by 'holders-pin-h2'; collection ends at min(T8_H_collect_max, T8_H2_end + 30 h) with status holders_collection_complete; a freeze slip is recorded, never extended. Disk: output cap 0.15 GB (reviewed cost amendment: about 1.9 MB a day for 63 days plus plans; the cap counts the whole run directory); a full cap is the declared sticky end state disk_budget (exit 4, never retried), H1-rep then 'not run (disk budget)'. Wallets: HMAC first 32 hex via cb8_common.load_wallet_key_strict (never creates a key; exit 2 on a missing or mode-unsafe key or a fingerprint mismatch vs wallet_key_fingerprint in seals/cb8_holders_rules.json); fingerprint in every manifest. Collection only; no analysis. Review amendments 2026-10-17: a plan still unfinished after UTC midnight is consolidated and marked <day>.INCOMPLETE.json (n_planned, n_done); idle waits for 'no complete capture <= 2.5 h old' and for data-dumps headroom return exit 0 idle_heartbeat (idle_kind no_fresh_capture / headroom) at least every 10 h instead of exhausting the 48-tempfail limit; holders-pin-h2 refuses a start earlier than the pin time + 2 h and records the pin time; --disk-cap-gb must equal the declared cap or the job exits 2.
